verdict_reason: New IT proves the non-prod AC against a real Mongo (expireAt stamped from config, TTL index shape, live and tombstoned addresses removed, undated and unexpired kept) and restores the shared container after each test; one Minor latent flake from millisecond truncation.

todos.issue: post_givesTheNewAddressAnExpireAtSevenDaysAhead compares the stored expireAt against un-truncated Instant.now() bounds: Mongo stores dates to the millisecond, so when the service stamps expireAt in the same millisecond as 'before' the read-back value is below before+7d and isBetween fails intermittently.
todos.fix: Truncate the lower bound to the stored precision: Instant before = Instant.now().truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.MILLIS).
